sources.title: Common Country Analysis 2024
sources.organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator Office, Maldives
sources.temporal_coverage: UN Country Analysis 2024, including climate projections, 2024 social context and historical island water shortages.
sources.methodology: UNCT input, risk-matrix survey, desk review and statistics.
sources.limitations: Geographic and demographic data gaps; evidence dates vary.

sources.title: Common Country Analysis Maldives (January 2021)
sources.temporal_coverage: UN CCA prepared/endorsed in January 2021; cited climate, water and gender evidence includes earlier years.
sources.methodology: UN system collective country assessment drawing on national and UN data, sector reports and cited studies.
sources.limitations: Historical national-level analysis; the conditional food-scarcity and sexual-exploitation risk is not an incident estimate.

sources.title: Strengthening National and Subnational Capacity for Sustainable Disaster Risk Reduction, Climate Change Adaptation and Mitigation in Maldives
sources.organization: United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (ESCAP)
sources.temporal_coverage: Climate hazard and sector exposure projections through 2060, with current risk-planning recommendations.
sources.methodology: ESCAP overlays downscaled projections with population, agriculture, infrastructure and land-use layers.
sources.limitations: Model, population, land-use and infrastructure data have stated gaps.

sources.title: Disaster Statistics of Maldives 2024
sources.organization: National Disaster Management Authority, Government of Maldives
sources.temporal_coverage: NDMA incident collection from December 2023 through December 2024.
sources.methodology: NDMA incident reports and recorded government relief/recovery assistance, disaggregated by hazard, atoll and island.
sources.limitations: Report notes uneven remote-island reporting, no consistent affected-person disaggregation, and no systematic aid-effectiveness monitoring.

sources.title: Enhancing Climate Resilience and Food Security Project (ECRFS Project)
sources.organization: Ministry of Climate Change, Environment and Energy, Government of Maldives
sources.temporal_coverage: Ongoing project, 2025-2030; page reports activities through October 2026.
sources.methodology: Government project page summarizing design, site locations and project-reported implementation updates.
sources.limitations: Activities and outputs are project-reported; project objectives and expected outcomes are not evaluated impacts.

sources.title: CRM in Maldives: Strengthening synergies and alignment of DRR and climate action
sources.organization: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR)
sources.temporal_coverage: Technical assistance and capacity development completed during 2022-2024; case study published September 2025.
sources.methodology: UNDRR case study summarizing government and partner technical-assistance activities and reported strategy outputs.
sources.limitations: Institutional case study, not an independent evaluation of strategy implementation or subnational outcomes.

claims.locator: PDF pp.42-44, climate projections and local adaptation capacity gaps
claims.paraphrase: CMIP6 projects greatest rainfall and flood risk centrally, increases in northern atolls and declines in named southern atolls.
claims.scenario: Downscaled CMIP6 to 2100; higher increases under higher emissions.
claims.limitations: Modelled regional pattern, not island-level observed change.

claims.paraphrase: CCA says migrant precarity and weak legal protection heighten climate-related displacement and livelihood risks.
claims.limitations: Risk statement, not a displacement count.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: Weak protection compounds climate displacement risk.

claims.locator: PDF p.44, adaptation capability and participation gaps
claims.paraphrase: CCA flags local risk-data capacity, community participation and cross-sector integration gaps.
claims.limitations: System-level gap summary, not a council-by-council audit.

claims.locator: PDF pp.72-74, risk matrix on climate-induced internal migration
claims.paraphrase: Risk matrix flags climate-induced atoll-to-Malé migration as a social-cohesion, settlement-crowding and housing/WASH risk.
claims.scenario: Risk-matrix entry; no scenario or period stated.
claims.limitations: Risk-matrix finding, not a measured migration or cohesion effect.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: CCA links climate mobility with cohesion and service pressure.

claims.locator: PDF printed p.60, disaster response, water insecurity and gendered risks
claims.paraphrase: The 2021 CCA says climate-related water and sanitation disruption affected women and girls' hygiene and relief participation; drought-related food scarcity may push women and girls toward transactional sex.
claims.scenario: Conditional risk in 2021 CCA; no climate scenario or future period stated.
claims.limitations: Dated conditional risk, not a measured incidence or current prevalence.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: CCA states food scarcity may lead women and girls to transactional sex for necessities.

claims.locator: PDF p.42, sea-level exposure by atoll through 2060
claims.paraphrase: By 2060, ESCAP estimates 47 percent of Meemu's population and over 30 percent in four other atolls exposed to sea-level rise exceeding one metre.
claims.scenario: SSP2 and SSP3 projections to 2060, as reported by ESCAP.
claims.limitations: Modelled exposure, not current affected counts.

claims.locator: PDF pp.45-46, disability inclusion and agriculture exposure
claims.paraphrase: ESCAP says warnings and preparedness are often inaccessible to disabled people; half may face high rainfall by 2060.
claims.scenario: High-rainfall exposure under SSP3 7.0 by 2060; accessibility barrier described in the report's current assessment.
claims.limitations: Accessibility was not assessed island by island.

claims.locator: PDF pp.46-48, food-producing islands and future rainfall exposure
claims.paraphrase: Thoddoo, Kashidhoo and Kaafu farms face high rainfall; low-lying fields in Gnaviyani, Seenu, Haa Dhaalu and Raa face sea-level rise.
claims.scenario: High rainfall and SSP3 7.0 sea-level exposure through 2060.
claims.limitations: Some land-use and population layers are incomplete.

claims.locator: PDF pp.2, 11-16, and 20, island hazard records and data/response limitations
claims.paraphrase: NDMA recorded 251 mixed-hazard incidents across 20 atolls in 2024 and 1,423 flood-affected households; Kaafu, Seenu and Laamu had the most reported rainwater floods.
claims.limitations: The incident total combines climate-related and non-climate hazards; it is not an attribution of all events to climate change.

claims.locator: PDF p.20, NDMA 2024 challenges and recommendations
claims.paraphrase: NDMA reports remote-island underreporting, limited demographic disaggregation, no systematic aid-effectiveness tracking and mostly reactive response without predefined island contingency plans.
claims.limitations: Report's recommendations are proposals; they are not evidence that the identified gaps have since been resolved.

claims.locator: Government project page, 26-27 August 2026 Ghaazee School Garden update
claims.paraphrase: ECRFS reported practical climate-smart gardening training for 88 students and school staff at Ghaazee School in August 2026, with continued technical support planned.
institutions: Ministry of Climate Change, Environment and Energy
claims.limitations: The page reports activity and participation, not sustained production, learning or food-security effects.

claims.locator: Government project page, 9 September 2026 Addu Meedhoo forecasting discussion
claims.paraphrase: ECRFS and Maldives Meteorological Service discussed a localized farm-weather pilot for Addu Meedhoo, but still planned to assess feasibility and data needs.
claims.scenario: Proposed pilot; feasibility and implementation were not yet established in the page.
claims.limitations: This was a planning discussion, not an operational pilot or demonstrated service outcome.

claims.locator: UNDRR case study, activities and outcomes, 2022-2025
claims.paraphrase: UNDRR reports its technical support helped align the Maldives' national DRR Strategy 2024-2030 with adaptation planning and integrate hazard assessments across government agencies.
institutions: Ministry of Climate Change, Environment and Energy
claims.limitations: UNDRR reports institutional outputs; the case study does not evaluate implementation or local results.

access_audit.locator: Full 75-page October 2024 CCA inspected; cited p.30, pp.42-44 and pp.72-74.
access_audit.notes: Used CCA-specific claims only; it reports significant geographic, gender and age data gaps.
access_audit.reuse_terms: Terms not reviewed; concise paraphrase only.

access_audit.locator: Full 126-page CCA inspected, especially printed p.60 on disaster response, water scarcity and gendered risks.
access_audit.notes: Publication page dates the report 31 December 2020; CCA itself was endorsed in January 2021. Claims are historical/conditional.
access_audit.reuse_terms: Terms not reviewed; concise paraphrase only.

access_audit.locator: Full 76-page ESCAP assessment inspected; cited printed pp.42 and 45-48 for exposure, disability and agriculture.
access_audit.notes: Document cover did not state a reliable publication date; filename date not used. Model and data limitations are retained.
access_audit.reuse_terms: Terms not reviewed; concise paraphrase only.

access_audit.locator: Full 22-page Disaster Statistics of Maldives 2024 inspected, including executive summary, atoll/island tables and p.20 limitations.
access_audit.notes: Data refer to December 2023-December 2024; publication date was not stated in the accessed report.
access_audit.reuse_terms: Terms not reviewed; concise paraphrase only.

access_audit.locator: Government project page; reviewed current project description and 26-27 Aug and 9 Sep 2026 updates.
access_audit.notes: Training is reported as completed; Addu Meedhoo forecasting pilot remained under feasibility assessment.
access_audit.reuse_terms: Terms not reviewed; concise paraphrase only.

access_audit.locator: Full UNDRR case page inspected, especially activities and outcome statements for 2022-2025.
access_audit.notes: Reported outcomes concern national strategies and inter-agency coordination, not measured local risk reduction.
access_audit.reuse_terms: Terms not reviewed; concise paraphrase only.

search_audit.query: Maldives official island and atoll climate risk reports, local rainfall, flood, sea-level, agricultural and disability exposure
search_audit.outcome: UN CCA and ESCAP provide named atoll and site projections; NDMA lists 2024 incident patterns by atoll and island. ESCAP flags model and spatial-data limits.

search_audit.query: Maldives official climate, drought, water insecurity, gender, migration, exploitation and protection risk links
search_audit.outcome: The 2021 CCA conditionally links climate-related livelihood and food scarcity to transactional-sex risk; the 2024 CCA links migrant precarity and legal-protection gaps to climate displacement and livelihood risks. No direct armed-conflict link found.

search_audit.query: Maldives primary sources on political or social insecurity, violence, displacement or other FCV factors obstructing climate adaptation and disaster-response delivery
search_audit.outcome: Reviewed CCA, NDMA, ESCAP and UNDRR materials did not establish violence or political insecurity blocking a named climate-adaptation intervention; NDMA instead records data, planning and response-system gaps.

search_audit.query: Maldives local climate adaptation, early warning, island-level preparedness, women and community capacity government and UN outcomes
search_audit.outcome: NDMA documents response and planning gaps; UNDRR reports aligned national strategy outputs; ECRFS reports Ghaazee School gardening training and an Addu Meedhoo pilot still under feasibility review.

gaps: No reviewed primary source tied armed conflict or political violence to Maldives climate exposure or documented insecurity preventing a named adaptation activity; absence of evidence in this search is not evidence of no link.
The 2021 CCA's climate-related food-scarcity and transactional-sex pathway is a conditional historical risk statement, not a measured rate or present-day estimate.
The ESCAP report's exposure projections have model, population, land-use and infrastructure-location limitations; some islands are undercounted or unverified.
NDMA's 2024 incident total combines climate and non-climate hazards and its own report identifies remote-island reporting, demographic disaggregation, aid-monitoring and anticipatory-planning gaps.

The large government ECRFS Gender Assessment and Action Plan PDF was not fully accessible through web retrieval; only its official indexed excerpt was inspected and it is not used for claims in this file.
